The '''Volgastan Baathist Republic''', also called the '''Baathist Republic of Volgastan''', is a major Khalari state established in 1953.

== Geography ==

The Khalari source places Volgastan in the heart of [[Khalari]], with extensive hot deserts in its central and northern areas. It describes the Dhah River as a major river corridor supporting forests and settlement, while the southern coastline contains seasonal forests, wetlands, temperate rainforest pockets, cities, and large ports.

The 2003 and 2022 reference maps show Volgastan as one of the largest eastern states, bordered or neighbored by several Khalari powers, including the [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]].

== Postwar State ==

The source infobox gives 1953 as the establishment date, after the collapse of the [[Vesperan Empire]] and the [[Continuation War]] period. Earlier Volgastani history is linked to the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]], but this draft does not assume a simple one-state succession without more source support.

The source names Sharaf el-Bashir, Abderrahman Al-Salimi, and Mustafar Kaliph Shah, but it does not clearly date their offices for the 1994-back pass. They are therefore preserved as source-named figures, not fixed 1994 rulers.

== Regional Power ==

Volgastan is described as a regional powerhouse and is nicknamed "The Beast in the East" in the source. Its unity, ports, deserts, and large population made it a major Khalari actor.

By the 1980s and early 1990s, Volgastan became associated with the [[Volgastani Expansionist Doctrine]], using weak Istragarde enforcement to press territorial and cultural-protection claims. The [[Istragarde Tribunal]] issued rulings against Volgastan, but the treaty system lacked the force to impose compliance.
